full_prompt_en: A square graphic illustration shows several office workers walking in different directions across a flat pale gray field. The largest figure is a man in the center-left foreground, seen in side and slight rear view. He wears a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers, one hand in a pocket, and strides toward the left with a long shadow beneath his shoes. His black hair and dark belt are rendered as simple solid shapes. At the far left, two smaller figures pass one another, one in a dark dress and one in light shirt and dark pants. Across the back middle, a few gray silhouettes walk toward the right, their bodies fading against the neutral ground. On the right, a woman in a white blouse and black knee-length skirt walks leftward, carrying a small bag. The image contains no buildings, pavement markings, or sky; the implied public space is communicated entirely by the walking poses and cast shadows. Bodies are made from broad flat blocks of white, black, and several grays with very little facial detail. Sharp contour edges and measured negative space keep each person distinct. The light appears high and directional enough to cast compact dark shadows, but the scene remains almost diagrammatic. The crowd feels ordinary and anonymous rather than dramatic. The strong foreground stride supplies motion, while receding smaller figures give a shallow sense of depth. The composition is balanced through alternating dark and light silhouettes across the otherwise empty field. Its visual language is economical, urban, and crisp, reducing a brief street moment to rhythm, spacing, and shape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形插画呈现数名上班族在平坦浅灰色域中朝不同方向行走。最大的人物在左前景中央，以侧身和略背面的角度出现。他穿白长袖衬衫和黑裤，一只手插兜，迈大步向左，鞋下拖着长影。黑发与深腰带化为简单实心形状。最左边两个较小人物擦身而过，一人穿深色裙，一人穿浅衬衫与深裤。后方中部几个灰剪影向右走，身体在中性色底上渐淡。右边一名白衬衫和及膝黑裙女子向左走，拎着小包。图像没有建筑、地面标记或天空；隐含公共空间全靠行走姿态与投影传达。身体由白、黑和几级灰的大块扁平区域构成，几乎没有面部细节。锐利轮廓边缘和有分寸的留白让每个人分明。光似乎从高处有方向地照来，足以投出紧凑深影，场景仍近乎图解。人群普通而匿名，不具戏剧性。有力前景步伐提供运动，退远的较小人物给出浅层纵深。构图靠空白色域上交替出现的深浅剪影平衡。视觉语言经济、都市、清晰，把短暂街头一刻化为节奏、间距和形状。
style_prompt_en: Flat graphic illustration reduces observed forms to a few crisp black, white, and gray silhouettes on a uniform neutral ground. Use hard edges, minimal internal detail, and measured spacing between differently scaled figures or objects. Compact cast shadows can signal direction and slight depth without building a full environment. Let one larger foreground shape set the motion, with smaller, paler marks receding across the frame. The economy of color and contour creates a clean urban rhythm; preserve enough posture and asymmetry to keep the scene human rather than schematic.
style_prompt_zh: 扁平图形插画把观察到的形体简化为均匀中性底上的少量黑、白、灰剪影。使用硬边、极少内部细节，以及不同尺度形体间有分寸的间距。紧凑投影可暗示方向和浅纵深，无须构造完整环境。一个较大前景形状确定运动，较小、较浅的痕迹横过画面退远。节省的颜色与轮廓形成干净都市节奏；保留足够姿态和不对称，使场景有人味而非纯图解。
